cohort: The study included 9,207 women with a history of at least one cesarean section.
finding: Uterine isthmocele was identified in 0.63% of women with previous cesarean sections, most commonly presenting with abnormal uterine bleeding, and its prevalence was highest in women with three cesarean scars.
mod_finding: Women with three cesarean scars had the highest prevalence of isthmocele (46.5%).
